column1: # Sink concept -> downstream SinkType operation vocabulary. One row per sink concept:
# Consumed by `vyql scan -format graph-json` (cmd/vyql/graphjson.go) to stamp each
# finding's sink with the consuming service's operation vocabulary. Kept as data so the
# cmd runtime hardcodes no ontology or domain knowledge.
# Every left-hand name must resolve to a concept in ontology/concepts -- the
# TestSinkOperationsExportResolves gate enforces it, because the loader treats a
# missing or unreadable file as an empty mapping rather than an error.
